meta.promptText: I want to buy running shoes under ₹3000 in India. Which ones should I get?

response.text:
Finding a great pair of running shoes under ₹3000 in India is entirely possible, especially if you look out for online sales on platforms like Amazon, Myntra, or brand-specific websites (like Adidas and Puma) where entry-level performance models frequently drop into this price bracket.[www.mensxp.com](https://www.mensxp.com/fashion/shoes/47756-these-are-the-best-running-shoes-under-rs-3000-for-men-who-are-all-for-fitness.html#:~:text=Be%20it%20their%20swanky%20and,%C2%A9%20Amazon)

Here are some of the best running and jogging shoes available around or under ₹3000:

---

### Top Recommendations

| Brand & Model | Best Suited For | Why It’s a Good Pick | Estimated Price Range |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Adidas Runfalcon series** (e.g., Runfalcon 5) | Beginners, gym workouts, & short daily jogs | Features a stable EVA foam midsole, breathable mesh upper, and solid rubber outsole durability. | Often drops to ₹2,500 – ₹3,000 during sales |
| **Campus Running Shoes** (Various models) | Budget-friendly daily wear & casual walking/running | Highly popular Indian brand known for incredible value, decent cushioning, and great durability for the price. | ₹1,500 – ₹2,200 |
| **Red Tape Sports Shoes** (Flow Plus series) | Casual runners & all-day comfort | Features soft insoles, good shock absorption, and soft ankle collars which make them comfortable right out of the box. | ₹1,500 – ₹2,500 |
| **Puma entry-level running models** | Gym-to-street versatility & light jogs | Lightweight, breathable upper materials with decent traction outsoles for casual fitness activities. | ₹2,000 – ₹3,000 (during discounts) |
| **HRX by Hrithik Roshan Sports Shoes** | Fitness beginners & daily walkers | Good arch support, lightweight build, and stylish colorways common in the budget sports segment. | ₹1,800 – ₹2,800 |

---

### Quick Tips Before You Buy:

* **Check for Sales:** Premium brands like Adidas and Puma often list their entry models above ₹4,000, but seasonal sales (like Amazon Great Indian Festival, Flipkart Big Billion Days, or Myntra EORS) routinely bring them straight down into the ₹2,000–₹3,000 bracket.
* **Purpose Matters:** If you plan on doing serious distance running (5km+ daily), look for models with dedicated rubber outsoles and responsive EVA midsoles (like the Adidas Runfalcon line) rather than lifestyle sneakers.
* **Sizing:** Athletic running shoes often fit slightly snug due to toe padding. If you are on the borderline between two sizes, going up half a size can prevent toe friction during runs.
